spine: 1. 程式要的是可以放進分支的值，不是一段文字：決策模型回傳有型別的答案加機率，供程式路由、升級或交給人。
2. 分類器的標籤偏固定、LLM 的輸出太開放且非確定性；決策模型夾在中間，由呼叫端給定輸出範圍並附機率（部分為作者推測，已標示）。
3. 機率讓門檻成為可調參數，但門檻有意義的前提是校準；兩篇貼文都沒有給校準曲線。
4. 決策步驟為非自迴歸、沒有中間文字，是貼文給的速度理由；機制描述很短，動畫僅為示意。
5. 證據全是 Cloudflare 自行發表：2.2s 對 4.7s 的網域分類例子不是同條件比較；Jev Decision Index 十列中 Clef 系列拿七列，個別評測仍輸給 Jev 或 DiffusionGemma Jev；Laya 中位數最快但 p95 高於 Clef-flash。
6. 第二篇貼文：Clef-flash 降價並把託管 context 縮到 24k，Clef 託管端提速 1.7 至 2.0 倍，Clef-omni 加入音訊與影片但在部分任務落後 Clef。
7. 讀者的行動：把 LLM 呼叫加解析加分支的流程換成決策模型來評估，但校準、任務適配、輸入長度與 p95 都要用自己的資料量。

perspective.mechanism: 決策模型回傳有型別、帶機率的輸出供程式分支；決策步驟非自迴歸，沒有中間文字要逐 token 生成。
perspective.tradeoff: Clef 在多數精選評測領先但個別評測輸給 Jev 或 DiffusionGemma Jev；Clef-flash 與 Clef 在不同任務強弱互換；微調可能犧牲通用能力；產品仍在早期。
perspective.reader_use: 台灣工程師可評估把現有的 LLM 呼叫加解析加分支流程換成決策模型，並用自己的資料量校準、準確率與 p95 延遲。

perspective.mechanism: 託管端改用 SGLang 等優化讓 Clef 中位延遲降 1.7 至 2.0 倍；Clef-omni 建立在 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct 上，單次呼叫接受文字、圖片、音訊與影片。
perspective.tradeoff: Clef-flash 降價但託管 context 從 64k 縮到 24k；Clef-omni 多模態但在部分任務落後 Clef。
perspective.reader_use: 依輸入長度與模態決定用哪個模型；Jev-API 相容，試用只需換 model ID。

notes.quote: A decision model makes classifications to help agents decide how to act, based on certain probabilities.
notes.interpretation: 貼文對決策模型的核心定義。

notes.quote: A decision model will return typed answers with probabilities (outputs),
notes.interpretation: 輸出是有型別的答案加機率，即本文所說的有界輸出。

notes.quote: which your code can use to route the ticket, trigger an escalation, or defer to a human.
notes.interpretation: 三個動作都是程式裡的分支，模型輸出接到分支。

notes.quote: For example, you can pass in a customer support message (inputs) and ask if it is urgent and which team should handle it.
notes.interpretation: 貼文自己的客服訊息範例，本文開場情境與互動圖的示意情境由此改編（圖中數值為作者示意）。

notes.quote: While classifier models have been around for some time
notes.interpretation: 貼文承認分類模型不是新東西，並說 Jev 帶來新的決策模型概念。

notes.quote: largely non-deterministic
notes.interpretation: 貼文對 LLM 的描述，用 largely 加以保留；本文據此講 LLM 輸出較不穩定，解析負擔屬作者一般經驗並已標示。

notes.quote: Clef is currently the leader when evaluated against the Jev Decision Index
notes.interpretation: 廠商自行主張的領先，用 currently 限定時間點；非第三方結果。

notes.quote: We shortlisted some evaluations below that are important for decision-making as defined by the Jev Decision Index
notes.interpretation: 表格是 Cloudflare 精選過的子集，不是完整指數。

notes.quote: BFCL · case exact
notes.interpretation: Jev Decision Index 表中的列標籤。本文表格十列（BFCL、ToolRet、API-Bank、Home appliances、When2Call、BANKING77、CLINC150+OOS、BRIGHT、Amazon ESCI、PhishNChips）與 Clef、Clef-flash、Jev、DiffusionGemma Jev 四欄分數皆抄自貼文表格；作者自數 Clef 系列拿七列、Jev 兩列、DiffusionGemma Jev 一列。

notes.quote: We also ran benchmarks across Typesafe’s own eval suite and our Clef models fared well, beating Jev in 3 out of 4 areas.
notes.interpretation: Typesafe 評測表四列：Invoice processing（Clef 64.7、Clef-flash 57.1、Jev 61.8）、Customer service（76.3、77、76.0）、Security incidents（62.9、61.7、61.7）、Agent trace observability（68.5、69.8、71.6）。

notes.quote: under an Apache 2.0 license for you to run locally and experiment with yourselves.
notes.interpretation: 權重以 Apache 2.0 釋出。

notes.quote: First, it has a vision encoder so it’s able to take in images and classify visual content.
notes.interpretation: Clef 相對 Jev 的第一項差異：能處理圖片。

notes.quote: Secondly, our model has a 64k context window (compared to Jev’s 32k),
notes.interpretation: Clef 64k 對 Jev 32k。

notes.quote: The decision step is non-autoregressive, so there’s no intermediate text to generate token by token,
notes.interpretation: 貼文給的速度理由，內部機制描述很短，動畫僅為示意。

notes.quote: Specifically at Cloudflare, we’ve been testing our new Clef model on our Threat Intelligence team
notes.interpretation: 網域分類例子的來源，搭配 Browser Run 使用。

notes.quote: This classification took our Clef model 2.2s to fetch, render, and classify the website.
notes.interpretation: 2.2 秒含抓取與渲染，模型本身只佔其中一段（貼文未拆分，為作者讀法）。

notes.quote: In contrast, our fastest general LLM gpt-oss-120b took 4.7s in the same workflow, and only returned two classifications.
notes.interpretation: 對照組 4.7 秒且只回兩個分類，輸出量不同，故非嚴格同條件比較（作者判斷）。

notes.quote: we don’t read, store, or train on your requests or responses
notes.interpretation: 隱私保證；選擇微調的客戶另當別論為貼文另處所述。

notes.quote: We are offering a service to help customers fine-tune Clef to suit their workloads with our hands-on FDE team.
notes.interpretation: RL 微調目前是人工服務，之後預計自助化。

notes.quote: We’re still early here and have a lot more improvements in store,
notes.interpretation: 產品仍在早期。

notes.quote: When you fine-tune a model, you may give up some general purpose performance
notes.interpretation: 微調的代價，用 may 保留。

notes.quote: Across the 43 eval benchmarks that we ran, our Clef models beat the decision models on latency
notes.interpretation: 延遲領先的主張，Laya 為例外。

notes.quote: except for Laya which is very fast but trades off quality in the benchmarks above
notes.interpretation: Laya 是例外：很快但品質較低。

notes.quote: Median latency · ms
notes.interpretation: 延遲表列標籤。中位數（Clef 209.3、Clef-flash 38.8、Jev 524.1、DiffusionGemma Jev 84.4、Kev-9B 51.4、Laya 5.8）與 p95（238.6、122.4、536.0、211.2、187.9、222.5）皆抄自貼文。

notes.quote: We currently use Qwen as the base model and post-trained it to suit decision model use cases.
notes.interpretation: 底座為 Qwen 並做後訓練。

notes.quote: Today, we’re releasing two Cloudflare-trained decision models,
notes.interpretation: 發布日為 2026-10-01（頁面中繼資料），兩個模型為 Clef 與 Clef-flash。

notes.quote: a human does not necessarily need to be in the loop for agentic decisions anymore
notes.interpretation: 用 necessarily 保留，不是完全拿掉人。

notes.quote: The larger Clef model is your more powerful precision model,
notes.interpretation: 較大的 Clef 定位為較強的精準模型。

notes.quote: These models are smarter, faster, and fully Jev-API compatible, so you can experiment with these hosted models easily.
notes.interpretation: 兩個模型與 Jev API 相容。

notes.quote: Clef-omni is able to take in audio (wav or mp3) and video (mp4 or webm) alongside text and images.
notes.interpretation: Clef-omni 的輸入格式。

notes.quote: Even a full 21-second video clip with sound is scored in about 1.5 seconds, all in a single API call.
notes.interpretation: 21 秒有聲影片約 1.5 秒；貼文只給 Clef-omni 的中位數，未列 p95。

notes.quote: Text-only decisions return in about 130 ms at the median, image inputs in about 150 ms,
notes.interpretation: 純文字約 130 ms、圖片約 150 ms；音訊為 a few hundred milliseconds。

notes.quote: $0.15 per M input tokens
notes.interpretation: Clef-omni 價格；Clef-flash 由 $0.09 降到 $0.038，Clef 維持 $0.24（皆為每百萬輸入 token）。

notes.quote: The hosted version of Clef-flash now has a context window of 24k, instead of 64k as previously advertised.
notes.interpretation: 託管版 context 縮減。

notes.quote: From our usage data, we see that only 0.24% of requests exceed 24k input tokens.
notes.interpretation: 縮減理由來自 Cloudflare 自家用量資料；輸入偏長的客戶可能落在那 0.24%（作者推論）。

notes.quote: The model weights on Hugging Face are untouched and were trained to support a 256k context window
notes.interpretation: 權重未動，自行部署可用到訓練長度。

notes.quote: We were able to optimize the model to the point where Clef-flash is now cheaper than Jev
notes.interpretation: 降價後比 Jev 便宜。

notes.quote: One of the optimizations we made was to move to SGLang for serving the model.
Our benchmarking shows strong performance across benchmarks, even with new modalities and MoE architecture.
notes.interpretation: Clef-omni 的整體說法；表格另顯示 Typesafe 發票處理 exact actions Clef-omni 60.2 對 Clef 64.7，BANKING77 macro-F1 Clef-omni 94.8 對 Clef 94.20。

notes.quote: Our public GitHub docs repo uses Clef to instantly detect and close spam issues.
notes.interpretation: 內部使用場景之一；另有 EmDash 外掛庫釣魚審查與 DLP 個資掃描，皆無準確率數字。

notes.quote: so it is as simple as changing the model ID to try out Clef today.
notes.interpretation: Jev-API 相容且可經 AI Gateway 使用，試用成本低。

notes.quote: where the model was already capable of processing text, imagery, audio, and video directly within a single pipeline
notes.interpretation: Clef-omni 建立在 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct MoE 基礎上，權重開放於 Hugging Face。

notes.quote: Calibrated, schema-bound decisions now seamlessly handle text, images, audio, and synchronized video in a single API call.
notes.interpretation: 貼文把產品描述為校準過、受 schema 約束的決策，但未給校準數字；Brier score 校準訓練出自貼文的訓練說明。

notes.quote: These models are capable enough to work over any set of inputs without constantly retraining the model to incorporate new classification categories.
notes.interpretation: 貼文對 Jev 這類決策模型能力的描述，Cloudflare 的轉述。

notes.quote: combining label-smoothed cross-entropy loss with Brier score calibration
notes.interpretation: Clef-omni 訓練用到 Brier score 校準。

notes.quote: which will be released in SGLang 0.5.22
notes.interpretation: SGLang 0.5.22 為預計版本，將來式。
